title: [main] bug 646167 - Enhance VIES Declaration pages: update option captions for declaration types
summary: VIES Declaration validation for declaration types is extracted into a dedicated procedure with an integration event, allowing localization partners to customize the handling of Corrective-Supplementary declarations through event subscription.
key_points: Validation logic moved from OnValidate trigger to CheckDeclarationType() procedure
OnBeforeCheckDeclarationType integration event introduced with IsHandled pattern for extensibility
SK localization can now override Corrective-Supplementary blocking without base app modifications
Consistent validation applied to both field and Export() action
CZ behavior unchanged; non-breaking refactor that enables customization
quote: By extracting the validation into a procedure with an integration event, SK localization can subscribe to OnBeforeCheckDeclarationType and set IsHandled := true
